parameters.query: SELECT * FROM students WHERE cohort = 'Spring 2024' LIMIT 1

INSERT INTO student_tasks (student_id, task_id, assigned_date, due_date) SELECT s.id, (SELECT id FROM tasks ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1), CURRENT_DATE, CURRENT_DATE + INTERVAL '7 days' FROM students s WHERE s.cohort = 'Spring 2024'
